name: dia
description: Ten reasoning-and-review skills that run on any assistant, with or without tools: dia-confirm confirms the goal before work, dia-elenchus and dia-brainstorm question an idea Socratically, dia-reductio tests a claim by strict contradiction, dia-negative critiques a claim by its own standard, dia-warrant tests how well an argument's reasons support its conclusion, dia-conjecture tests a universal claim by counterexamples, dia-counterplan builds the opposing plan from a plan's key assumptions, dia-refine reviews an answer once, and dia-iterate runs verification-gated review rounds.
